Subject: EOQ: Accountability roster + stage cleanse (finalize commits)

Team — quick, concrete ask for the next 48 hours as we lock the quarter. Finance needs an accurate forecast and stage hygiene so we can close bookings and issue SOW/POs. Please do the following by end of day tomorrow (Apr 23):

1) SFDC stage audit: mark deals as COMMIT, AT-RISK, or NO-GO. If you put COMMIT, add the commit owner and PO/PO pending date in the Notes field.
2) Numbers check: update the ACV and ARR fields to reflect the final handshake numbers (don’t leave placeholders).
3) Attachments: upload signed MA plan or last POC note to the deal record and link to the EOQ folder (Drive link below).
4) Owner confirmation: reply to this thread with a single-line ACK + expected funding timing (e.g., "ACK — PO expected 4/28").

I attached EOQ_Handoff_Template.xlsx and BrightByte_MA_plan_v3.docx — use the template when you add PO dates so Finance can consume the extract automatically. Priyom, please prioritize the three BrightByte seats and confirm the champion has signed the MA. Ben, please sweep West accounts and call out any gating procurement blockers. Marissa, if any deal needs leadership escalation for credit/discount signoff, flag it here and include a recommended mitigation.

Why this matters: finance will only include deals marked COMMIT with a linked PO/date in the official close; anything else will roll to next quarter. We need accuracy over optimism here.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEOQ-ROSTER
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/BB-2027-Q2-1074

Thanks — small focused steps, please.

—Monica
